title: Stormtrooper
description: Stormtroopers were the elite shock troopers of the Empire, serving loyally in posts across the galaxy in their imposing white armor. They would fanatically follow the orders of their superiors, handed down from the will of Emperor Sheev Palpatine himself. They would capture political prisoners, torture rebels, massacre settlements, or even fight Ewoks if their orders commanded it. They specialized in all manner of combat and had gear to survive in the many different climates found around the galaxy.
